title: Your Brain Edits Real Memories: Why 25% Recalled a Fake Day
topic: How Elizabeth Loftus Planted a Lost-in-the-Mall Memory in 25% of Adults
act5_climax_episode: In 1995 at the University of Washington, Elizabeth Loftus and Jacqueline Pickrell slipped one fabricated childhood shopping-mall disappearance into family story booklets — and 25% of healthy adults remembered the fake event with vivid invented details.
